notes.title: TSOTF - A Recap of Changes Since Launch
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/16930072/efd65fd1ee16b94e4d72e8303c8df3639f2d44d9.jpg[/img]

It's been a joy to watch the community participate in TSOTF matches this past week!  We've seen several nail-biting matches and clever uses of the new mechanics that TSOTF provides. It is a memorable experience for us to watch these high-intensity matches play out on a grand scale.  Who’d imagine we’d see little dilos, monkeys, and small creatures being mind-controlled at end-game!?  We'd also like to give a nod to the ARK content creation community for keeping our screens full of nonstop entertainment.

Since the original launch on Friday, Dec 23rd, balance changes have been made to several creatures including Thylacoleo, Rhino, Triceratops, Carcharodontosaurus, and Dragon. Changes have also been made to C4, fire/flame weapons, and bosses in the game. Several quality-of-life improvements have been added such as keybinds, total match time remaining on the HUD, and a confirmation prompt for converting to tokens. A parachute has been added as a lootable item and some optimizations have been made to the mini map, compass, on-screen text, and in-world POI UI/HUDs.

The [url=https://survivetheark.com/index.php?/forums/topic/674777-ark-the-survival-of-the-fittest-patch-notes-v4642846428/]patch notes thread[/url] contains the latest changes and updates for TSOTF.

notes.title: ARK: Survival of the Fittest Update
notes.notes:
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=663440839][img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/455236206129343287/45FC18CD445ED87E21FF6F67EE601172C1E785D9/[/img][/url]

ARK: Survival of the Fittest initially started as the original Total Conversion for ARK: Survival Evolved. It’s a game mode which puts places in a battle arena where they fight to the death. Since it’s inception in August 2015, it has undergone a lot of changes.

However, we are officially announce the hiatus of ARK: Survival of the Fittest. This means that there will be a halt in active development for the game mode whilst we consider our options for the game’s long-term direction. This also means that Survivor League will no longer run, for now. Please keep in mind that this may not be permanent, and there is active discussion surrounding the game mode’s future, including the possibility of a console port and development continuing, but for now we wanted to inform you that we would not be working on it plus no longer supporting it through competitive tournaments. The Official servers will remain online for the time being.

We understand that this may come as a disappointment to a number of you, Survival of the Fittest was a project we do love, but unfortunately, for now, it’s just not possible for us to scale up work on the title while also providing the necessary attention to ARK: Survival Evolved. However, we would like to give it a proper send-off: this winter we will be hosting two special matches to celebrate the game mode, as well as all who played it.

On Saturday the 17th of December at 11AM EST we would like to cordially invite the best SotF players to take part in an “All-Stars” 4-player-tribe game. The players will be invited based on their previous placements and accolades in Survivor League. This will be a standard 4-player match with the same settings as the October League, except the match timer will be scaled for 1.5 hours. All participants will be provided with a 20$ Steam Gift card, and the winning tribe will each receive a bonus 100$ Steam Gift card for their success! Following that match, we would like to host a final ~200-player Naughty vs Nice (to take place on The Island SotF Map) where the winning tribe’s players will receive a 50$ Steam Gift card (all hundred of them!).

In January, we will also release the Scorched Earth SotF source to the Survival of the Fittest Development Kit. The map environment itself is complete, however enterprising modders would need to add the dino-spawns, as well as make any other changes that they themselves deem necessary. We will also ensure all Survivors who have won over 200 SotF games in a set competitive game mode receive their Bionic Giga skin in ARK: Survival Evolved v253. Sorry, it took so long - we’re still waiting for our functionality from Valve but have managed to create our own workaround!

We’ll keep you informed should plans on SotF change next year, as we are still sourcing potential ways to give the game a substantial development outlook.

notes.title: ARK: Survival of the Fittest, Survivor League, and Summer Cup Update!
notes.notes:
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=663440839][img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/455236206129343287/45FC18CD445ED87E21FF6F67EE601172C1E785D9/[/img][/url]

Hello Survivors!

Since the first announcement of Survivor League, we have had constant feedback from the Community and we’ve been working together to figure out what would be the best way to run a competitive league for our players. 

During PAX we had the opportunity to meet up with many players, and discuss where we really wanted to go with Survivor League.

After many conversations with the community, a lot of the players who placed/ranked in the survivor league, people who stream SotF and other players and influencers in other competitive scenes gave us a ton of great feedback about the Survivor League, prizing, and tournaments/gameplay. 

This, combined with some metrics that were collected on the League, led us to make some pretty exciting changes to the upcoming way we will handle Survivor League, and these changes are made effective immediately in order to create a better League and competitive environment for our community and the game.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=663440839][img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/455236206129343287/45FC18CD445ED87E21FF6F67EE601172C1E785D9/[/img][/url]

[h1]Survival of the Fittest[/h1]

[b]6 Player Mode[/b]

[list]
[*]This “Official” game mode has been removed.
[/list]

Going through our metrics and speaking to many players it was evident that this game mode, in it’s current state and the current state of SotF, showed that it was not the most optimal way to host tournaments or host a practical official competitive scene. This could of course change in the future, but for now we would like to steer away from 6 versus 6 and focus on our more popular team-game modes, 2 Player Tribes and 4 Player Tribes.

[b]4 Player Mode[/b]

[list]
[*]This is now the primary tournament mode.
[/list]

This means that we will be using this mode to decide the players who are invited to take place in the Offline Summer Cup Championship Tournament matches based in Shanghai during ChinaJoy, where they will meet up with and compete against 4 top Chinese Tribes. As this is now the Tournament mode, it will enforce Tournament Graphic Settings. Namely this will be minimum Medium Quality with ground clutter turned on for fair and competitive gameplay.

[b]Adjusted Match Times[/b]

To make the 2v2 and 4v4 modes easier to play for people with less free time, we have adjusted the standard match times for these modes to 45 minutes (down from 60) for 2v2, and 60 minutes (down from 90) for 4v4. We’ve also added the Giganotosaurus, because Big Dinos :) 

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=656385516][img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/456361430270625980/143CD5950C4B69C31B139472013A2C1D338E9583/[/img][/url]

[h1]Survivor League[/h1]

[b]Finishing in the Top 10 no longer guarantees a prize.[/b]

Where you place on the Survivor League does not determine how high cash-prize you could possibly win, but instead only determines whether you qualify for the shout-casted end-of-month Survivor League Tournament match (which will itself yield the prizes).

[b]To qualify for the Survivor League Tournament you must place within the cut-off by the last day of the month:
[list]
[*]FFA: Top 40 Players
[*]2 Player Tribes: Top 60 Players
[*]4 Player Tribes: Top 80 Players
[/list][/b]
[b]The Tournament Match[/b]

This Tournament Match for each of the 3 Game Modes will take place on the first Saturday following the end of the month of the Survivor League qualification process. This means that the first tournament will then take place on: [b]June the 4th[/b].
There will be 3 tournaments that take place that day at 12pm Eastern, all to be streamed and shout-casted on www.twitch.tv/survivetheark with a 15 minute delay.

[b]Qualification for the Tournament does not guarantee a cash-prize.
To be eligible for a prize you must place in the Tournament Match:
[list]
[*]In the top 10 for FFA Mode
[*]The top 5 Tribes in 2 Player Mode
[*]The top 3 Tribes in 4 Player Mode
[/list][/b]
The winners will be entitled the ‘Survivor League’ for that month, and the qualification process for the next tournament would have already been underway, as that will always begin on the [b]1st of every month[/b].

[b]Survivor League Cash-Prizes[/b]

Due to the immediate removal of 6 Player Mode, the cash-prizes for Survivor League must change. The new values are listed as:

[b]FFA

[list]
[*]1st Place: $4000
[*]2nd Place: $3000
[*]3rd Place: $2000
[*]4th Place: $1800
[*]5th Place: $1600
[*]6th Place: $1400
[*]7th Place: $1200
[*]8th Place: $1000
[*]9th Place: $900
[*]10th Place: $800
[/list]

2 Player Tribes

[list]
[*]1st Place Tribe: $3500 per member
[*]2nd Place Tribe: $2500 per member
[*]3rd Place Tribe: $1800 per member
[*]4th Place Tribe: $1650 per member
[*]5th Place Tribe:  $1500 per member
[/list]

4 Player Tribes

[list]
[*]1st Place Tribe: $3500 per member
[*]2nd Place Tribe: $1800 per member
[*]3rd Place Tribe: $1200 per member
[/list][/b]
If a tribe does not have the maximum number of players, they will not receive the extra prize-pool. It is recommended that for these Tournaments, you are in a full-sized tribe to ensure that you have the opportunity to win the largest amount of prize available. A three-player tribe will not receive an extra $3500 for placing first.

[b]New Zero Tolerance on Teaming[/b]

Players found guilty of illegal teaming with the intent to manipulate the competitive system will be absolutely permanently banned from Survival of the Fittest. This includes but is not limited to: Survival of the Fittest the game, Survivor League’s Qualification Process, Survivor League Tournament and all future Wildcard Sponsored Tournaments. 

We do not tolerate teaming, however we understand that there are certain elements of the game where teaming may occur naturally, or in some cases have no effect due to the skill-level of the game. We will evaluate teaming reports on a case-by-case basis and collect video evidence to prosecute offenders. We will have an in-game report system, as well as in-game monitoring conducted by the Wildcard GM Team. The slate was wiped clean at the end of the first Survivor League, we will not be so lenient going forward. Don’t team, it’s not worth the disqualification!

[b]Sportsmanship[/b]

We understand that in the heat of the competition, emotions can get the best of us. We would like to remind all players to ensure that they have respect for each other during the games, you do not have to enjoy the company of the people you’re playing against, however there is no need to hurl verbal insults or harass members of the community, one which you’re a part of. We would like to make it clear that in future circumstances, players found showing a poor sense of sportsmanship may risk being banned from Survival of the Fittest. This includes but is not limited to: Survival of the Fittest the game, Survivor League’s Qualification Process, Survivor League Tournament and all future Wildcard Sponsored Tournaments.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=671498404][img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/448482024250529396/0D07781BCCFDF28B18910D1BB10DA4AA9E848E9B/[/img][/url]

[h1]Summers Cup Championship[/h1]

Due to the removal of the 6 versus 6 mode, there will be some necessary changes that will be made to the Summers Cup to take place at ChinaJoy in Shanghai.
[b][list]
[*]6 Player Tribes have been removed
[*]4 Player Tribes have now become the Official Tournament Mode
[*]Tournament Graphics will be enforced
[*]The 40 top scoring Summer Cup registered players from May and June each month will be invited to a Finals Match on July 1st. (80 Players in Total). We also may at our discretion invite additional contestants to complete 4-player Tribes, depending on their Score placement.
[*]The Top 8 Tribes (approximately 32 players in all) will be invited to ChinaJoy in Shanghai for the Offline Summer Cup Championship matches, where they’ll meet up to compete with 4 top Chinese Tribes.
[/list][/b]
We’d also like to address some points that we’ve seen from the Community in regards to the Summer Cup:

[b][list]
[*]You cannot compete in this Tournament if you are under the age of 18
[*]The top 40 unique registered players in the Tournament League for each month will be invited to the Finals Match, so if a Survivor has placed in the Top 40 twice, it will skip them and then grab the next-best player.  Similarly, if a player has placed in the top 40 but not registered for the Summer Cup, he or she will be skipped.
[*]Your Team Leader must ensure that when registering your team, you use the same Team Name and Survivor Name in the game, as well register all members of your team.
[*]You are permitted to have mixed-member teams from different regions, but all of your team members must, for the time being, hail from North America or European countries. Next Cups will include more regions.
[*]Teams in China will have their own qualification process and they will already be there ready to play for when you arrive for the finals.
[*]Graphical settings will be enforced for the qualification period and for the tournament.
[*]Going forward on our website, we will be displaying the concurrent Top 100 Players’ Scores in each mode, so you can see where you place and how close you are to qualifying for the Summer Cup Finals, and also for each Month’s Survivor League Tournament Match.
[/list][/b]
These changes are made effective immediately in order to create a better League and competitive environment for our community and the game. We’re going to release the patch so that you guys can start playing and get a feel for how everything is running. Thank you again for your ongoing support and we looking forward to hearing your feedback and making the necessary adjustments to improving the game.

All the best,

Wildcard Jat and the ARK: Survival of the Fittest Team

notes.title: April 2016 Survivor League Winners & SotF Update!
notes.notes:
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=656385516][img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/456361430270625980/143CD5950C4B69C31B139472013A2C1D338E9583/[/img][/url]

[h1]Survivor League Winners[/h1]

Congratulations to all the [url=https://survivetheark.com/index.php?/survivor-league/]winners[/url] who placed in our first Survivor League ever! It’s been an exciting time for ARK SotF players and we saw a wide variety of strategy used. Emotions ran high and the final list of players we have ended with are as follows;

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=666311333][img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/452985078877670553/33F14193F3DA122B64DE01767D395D26D913EA5F/[/img][/url]

They have earned a place in the Survivor League archive as well as their share of $64,800 in cash! The prizes are broken down as such:

[b]1st Place: $3500 
2nd Place: $2500
3rd Place: $1800 
4th Place: $1650
5th Place: $1500
6th Place: $1350
7th Place: $1200
8th Place: $1050
9th Place: $900
10th Place: $750[/b]

We’ll be reaching out to the winners over the coming days to collect the information required to get your prizes sent out to you! Look out for contact made by Jat! In the case where players share the same score but different rank, both will be awarded with the higher-cash prize. So in this case, both Cirar - Frittest Mayo and PedroSaltana[Ralph] will receive the prize for first place and then it will skip to Sr. Dinch in third place. So yes, the prize pool will be higher this month! :)

[h1]Upcoming changes made to SotF and Survivor League[/h1]

Survivor League will officially go on halt until May the 1st 2016 where we’ll begin the next round of games. This will include a soft-reset which will not affect your wins, but your other stats so your progress towards the Giga will be kept in-tact!

We will be making further changes to Survivor League which will be announced fairly soon, those changes will in-fact not take place until June’s Survivor League to adhere to our 30-day policy.

We will also be introducing Blind Matchmaking to the game within the next few days, we will use the period from now until the 1st of May to heavily iterate on it and make any changes that are necessary to matchmaking, as well as possible adjustments to how Scores are calculated for matches, to ensure that skilful players are being rewarded sufficiently for demonstrating their ability as the Fittest Survivors.

We are also super excited to announce that shortly we will be introducing Grappling Hooks to Survival of the Fittest! We are eager to see the new game play mechanics that this will bring into the game and how players will make use of this new form of maneuverability during combat.

With the excitement of future tournaments, our main-game mode designed around tournament-play will be receiving a graphical overhaul as well as a rename. 6-Player mode will now be known as Tournament Mode and it will automatically enable and enforce higher-graphical settings to make the game more competitive. These settings will be also used during our upcoming Official Tournaments, so players will now be able to get closer to a high-end competitive-experience when playing matches of this type. We want to ensure that you guys are able to train in the environments that you will compete in so we will attempt to recreate the exact Official Tournament specifications as much as possible, starting with this change.

[h1]Disqualification, Sportsmanship and the future of Survival of the Fittest[/h1]

Over the past few weeks we have had a lot of reports concerning the sportsmanship and behaviour of players in Survival of the Fittest throughout the community. We understand that in the heat of the competition, emotions can get the best of us. We would like to remind all players to ensure that they have respect for each other during the games, you do not have to enjoy the company of the people you’re playing against, however there is no need to hurl verbal insults or harass members of the community, one which you’re a part of. We would like to make it clear that in future circumstances, players found showing a poor sense of sportsmanship may risk being banned from Survival of the Fittest. 

Throughout this first month we have had to disqualify players due to heavy abuse of the matchmaking system when engaging in competitive matches. Players were found to be manipulating lobbies and exploiting the mechanics in an unintended way to gain an unfair advantage over their opponents. As stated in the FAQ, Studio Wildcard holds the authority and discretion to determine what gaining an unfair advantage would be and we will step in if necessary, like we have with this round of Survivor League. Players who were removed from April’s rankings will only suffer a one-time reset. They are still permitted to participate in future rounds, as well as tournaments but continuous abuse and manipulation of the system will result in absolute disqualification. We want to harbour a good environment where players are playing at the best and fairly. The game is still growing and it is subject to a lot of change based on these kinds of issues and feedback from the SotF community; with your help we can make sure that we’re able to achieve this.

As a free competitive game, the future of Survival of the Fittest lives by this community. For Survival of the Fittest to succeed, we need the community’s help by promoting the game, encouraging their friends to play it, helping out new players, giving us solid feedback on how to improve and working with us to make a better game. We really value your commitment and dedication to the game, and we want to ensure that we can make it grow and for Survival of the Fittest to be as special as you all wish it to be. Let’s work together to foster a positive community and a great competitive scene!

Thank you everyone for participating in April’s Survivor League! The next round of Survivor League will begin on May the 1st and will include the Grappling Hook, Blind Matchmaking and more (Giga...). We’re looking forward to seeing all SotF survivors play and continue to refine their strategies, skills, and teamwork!

All the best,

Wildcard Jat and the ARK: Survival of the Fittest Team.

p.s If you'd like to check out the Community Crunch, you can read it here! https://survivetheark.com/index.php?/articles.html/april-survivor-league-winners-sotf-update-community-crunch-44-r152/ - it includes some SotF tutorial videos from typeForced!

[h1]Survivor League Winners[/h1]

Congratulations to all the [url=https://survivetheark.com/index.php?/survivor-league/]winners[/url] who placed in our first Survivor League ever! It’s been an exciting time for ARK SotF players and we saw a wide variety of strategy used. Emotions ran high and the final list of players we have ended with are as follows;

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=666311333][img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/452985078877670553/33F14193F3DA122B64DE01767D395D26D913EA5F/[/img][/url]

They have earned a place in the Survivor League archive as well as their share of $64,800 in cash! The prizes are broken down as such:

[b]1st Place: $3500 
2nd Place: $2500
3rd Place: $1800 
4th Place: $1650
5th Place: $1500
6th Place: $1350
7th Place: $1200
8th Place: $1050
9th Place: $900
10th Place: $750[/b]

We’ll be reaching out to the winners over the coming days to collect the information required to get your prizes sent out to you! Look out for contact made by Jat! In the case where players share the same score but different rank, both will be awarded with the higher-cash prize. So in this case, both Cirar - Frittest Mayo and PedroSaltana[Ralph] will receive the prize for first place and then it will skip to Sr. Dinch in third place.
